- Sunleaf (richness: 5) [id: 8d09e2f0-63b] - this would be excellent
- Healroot (richness: 4) [id: 730411fe-f7f] - I just harvested from this one and it went idle
- Sunleaf (richness: 4) [id: 8042a225-6cf]
- Sunleaf (richness: 4) [id: b4fbedfb-963] - I just harvested from this one

*stretches and looks around at the abundant herb spawns scattered throughout the forest*

Well, that was productive. Time to keep building up my herb collection while these spawns are still rich. That Sunleaf patch over there looks particularly promising - richness 5 should give good yields and help improve my foraging skills.
